notes:
The sidebar list is now called Spaces, and the ＋ that adds one lives on its caption — the top bar no longer carries it.
A space row grows its own hover cluster: ⋯ opens the menu, ＋ starts an agent there.
The space menu spells its worktree verbs out — Merge to main and Delete worktree are their own rows, not one wrap-up.
That menu now opens directly under the dots that opened it, and the dots stay lit while it's open.
Removing a worktree closes every terminal inside it — managed tabs and diff views included.
